From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2025 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: Demo environment (Standard Demo v1) — exec sponsor check-in: timeline, success metrics, escalations

Markus / Talia,

Quick sponsor check-in as we head into the second half of the quarter.

1) Are we still on track for “Standard Demo v1” rollout in the 6–8 week window? What’s the current target date for field-ready?
2) What are we using as success metrics for v1 (demo reliability, setup/reset time, demo-to-eval conversion, etc.)? I want to make sure we’re measuring the right things and not setting ourselves up for a “pretty deck, flaky demo” situation.
3) Any product/ops work that needs escalation this week (SRE coverage, tenant automation, dashboard import stability, etc.)?

If helpful, I can do a 15 min unblocker with the right engineering sponsor(s), but I need a crisp ask.

Thanks,
Jordan

Jordan Blake
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference


---

From: Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2025 at 12:47 PM PST
Subject: Re: Demo environment (Standard Demo v1) — exec sponsor check-in: timeline, success metrics, escalations

Jordan,

Yes — still tracking to a field-ready v1 by end of week 7 (target: Fri, Feb 28). We’ve kept the scope tight (demo tenant + 4–6 known-good scenarios + deck/talk track + runbook).

Current success metrics (v1):
- Demo reliability rate: >= 95% “green” demos (no blocking issues) across internal dry runs + first 10 field demos
- Setup/reset time: <= 15 minutes for an SE to get from “haven’t touched it in a week” to “ready to run” (includes quota sanity check + dashboards)
- Known-good scenarios: 4 scenarios with canned inputs + expected outputs + Plan B steps documented
- Time-to-first-value (hosted mini-demo): <= 2 minutes to first streamed response in live call
- Demo-to-eval conversion: directional only for v1 (we’ll instrument and set a baseline; not using it as a pass/fail gate)

Risks / potential escalation:
- Demo tenant automation (ENG-4920): we’re close, but we need platform to confirm the reset script is truly idempotent + permissions are locked down.
- Monitoring + alerting (ENG-4922): dashboard import is stable in our sandbox but we’ve had 1 issue with missing panels when moving between environments.
- SRE “business hours” oncall path for demo incidents: we have a draft plan, but I’d like Sean to confirm coverage expectations before we socialize it to the field.

Next step: I’ll attach a one-page weekly status for you to skim. If you’re willing to ping Priya Natarajan (platform sponsor) to get 30 minutes on the calendar this week, that would help de-risk the automation/reset and access controls.

Attachment: Standard Demo v1 — Exec Sponsor Weekly Status (1-pager).pdf

Thanks,
Talia

Talia Benson
Program Manager, GTM Enablement Programs
Redwood Inference


---

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2025 at 2:08 PM PST
Subject: Re: Demo environment (Standard Demo v1) — exec sponsor check-in: timeline, success metrics, escalations

+1 to Talia’s summary.

A bit more color from the field/Solutions Eng side:

Scenarios we’re standardizing for v1 (4 core, 2 optional):
1) Streaming chat + “fast first token” (Hosted) — shows latency + developer experience.
2) Cost controls (batching/caching knobs) + token-level breakdown in Console — shows unit economics.
3) Reliability: routing + fallback between pinned model variants — shows graceful degradation, not just happy path.
4) Observability: per-route latency/error dashboards + trace linkout — shows ops readiness.
Optional branches depending on persona/time:
5) Tool/function calling or structured output
6) Private/VPC narrative (security persona) — talk track + slide, not necessarily a live on-prem deploy.

Escalation need (small but real): there’s one Console label/flow that’s confusing during the live clickpath for fallback policy. Product has a small fix in flight (GitHub redwood/pr-22031). If that slips, we can still demo, but it adds “narration overhead” and increases risk of a live fumble.

Also: we’re intentionally keeping benchmark numbers as ranges (safe claims only) to avoid getting trapped in a prospect-specific debate mid-demo.

Markus

Markus Klein
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 15, 2025 at 8:26 AM PST
Subject: Re: Demo environment (Standard Demo v1) — exec sponsor check-in: timeline, success metrics, escalations

This is solid.

A few directives so we don’t drift:
- Reliability metric matters more than deck polish. If something has to slip, it’s not the runbook/reset automation.
- Keep pricing out of the deck. Ranges are fine; any hard numbers should be “if asked” and only with approved language.
- Make the 2-minute hosted mini-demo a first-class path (we keep getting asked for it).

Sean — can you reply in-thread with what you’re comfortable committing to for business-hours coverage + what you need from the team to make it low-drama?

Talia — please set a weekly 15 min sponsor touchpoint through end of Feb and include:
1) rollout ETA
2) demo reliability status (dry runs + any field demos)
3) open escalations (with named owner + date)

Also, I’ll ping Priya today and ask for a 30 min unblocker on reset/idempotency/access control.

Jordan

From: Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 21, 2025 at 4:38 PM PST
Subject: Re: Demo environment (Standard Demo v1) — exec sponsor check-in: timeline, success metrics, escalations

Jordan,

Weekly sponsor touchpoint is on the calendar (Weds 9:30am PT through Feb).

This week’s status (high level):
- Schedule: still on track for Feb 28 field-ready.
- Reliability: 2 internal dry runs completed. 1 issue found (dashboard panel missing after import) — tracked under ENG-4922 follow-up; workaround is documented in the runbook draft.
- Reset automation: draft script is working in staging; waiting on platform review for access scope + idempotency (ENG-4920).

Escalations / asks:
1) Priya — can you confirm a platform reviewer for the reset module by end of week? We want a “yes/no” on whether the current approach is supportable before we socialize broadly.
2) Sean — still need your guidance on the demo incident path (who is paged, what counts as P0 vs “switch to Plan B”). We’re trying to avoid telling the field “page SRE” without a clear definition.

Also aligned on your directive: runbook + reset automation is the critical path. Soojin is updating talk track to avoid hard numbers (only approved ranges + “if asked” appendix).

Thanks,
Talia

Talia Benson
Program Manager, GTM Enablement Programs
Redwood Inference
